summary: Backend regression verified for the Box external-source slug bug fix. 6/6 new tests in test_box_slug_fix.py pass + 18/18 (1 skipped) regression tests pass across test_admin_invite_role_scope.py, test_vault_preview.py, test_preview_images.py. End-to-end probe with a bogus Composio connected_account_id now returns code 1810 ActionExecute_ConnectedAccountNotFound for tool BOX_LIST_ITEMS_IN_FOLDER — proving the slug resolves at Composio. The old 404 Tool_ToolNotFound for BOX_LIST_FILES is gone. Default folder_id='0' branch + non-file entry skip branch verified statically in server.py.

minor.issue: FOLDER_PARAM_KEY dict at server.py:4878 keys OneDrive/SharePoint as 'one_drive' / 'share_point' (toolkit slug form), but src['source_kind'] from ExternalSourceCreate is 'onedrive' / 'sharepoint' (no underscore). The .get() therefore falls back to default 'folder_id' for both — which happens to be the right key for OneDrive/SharePoint so the bug is latent, but the lookup never actually hits its mapped value. Worth aligning the keys to source_kind to remove dead branches. Not in scope for this bug.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix at /app/backend/server.py:4413 is correct: COMPOSIO_FILE_SOURCES['box']['list'] now 'BOX_LIST_ITEMS_IN_FOLDER'. Composio v3 confirms this slug exists (returns 1810 ConnectedAccountNotFound for a bogus connected_account_id rather than 404 Tool_ToolNotFound).
Default folder_id='0' branch at server.py:4933-4936 correctly handles Box's requirement that root folder be specified explicitly.
Entry-type filter at server.py:4986-4992 correctly skips folders + web_links so they never get fed to BOX_DOWNLOAD_FILE.

Other 4 providers (googledrive/onedrive/sharepoint/dropbox) keep their original list slugs (GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_FILES, ONE_DRIVE_LIST_FILES, SHARE_POINT_LIST_FILES, DROPBOX_LIST_FILES) — verified via static block extraction.

Minor: FOLDER_PARAM_KEY at server.py:4878 uses underscored keys ('one_drive', 'share_point') that never match the unprefixed source_kind values — dead branches. Cosmetic cleanup, no functional impact today.
server.py still exceeds 9600 lines — flagged in prior iterations; splitting auth/admin/listings/collab/vault into modules would significantly help maintainability. Out of scope for this bug.

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 new + 18/18 regression pytest tests passed; 1 conditional skip)

seed_data_creation: One throwaway Box source row (label TEST_box_<hex>) was created on Mira's first listing during the run; the test cleans it up via direct Mongo delete in test_cleanup_box_source. Verified post-run that listing_external_sources has no TEST_box_ leftovers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_box_slug_fix.py on any future change to COMPOSIO_FILE_SOURCES (server.py:4408), _run_external_source_sync (server.py:4917+), or the sync trigger endpoint (server.py:5116). The E2E test asserts the last_error string contains a ConnectedAccount signal AND does NOT contain Tool_ToolNotFound / BOX_LIST_FILES — these are the exact signals that flip if Composio renames the action again.
rca of the issue: Composio renamed Box's list action from BOX_LIST_FILES to BOX_LIST_ITEMS_IN_FOLDER (with required folder_id arg; '0' = root). Before the fix, /external-sources/{sid}/sync calls landed at /api/v3/tools/execute/BOX_LIST_FILES → 404 Tool_ToolNotFound (code 2401) and persisted as listing_external_sources.last_error. After the fix, the same flow with a bogus connected_account_id now yields 'No connected account found with ID ca_bogus_... for toolkit box' (code 1810 ActionExecute_ConnectedAccountNotFound) — confirming the tool exists at Composio and only the (intentionally fake) credentials were rejected. Mitigation: action slug updated; companion logic adds default folder_id='0' for Box list calls and filters folders/web_links out of the download loop.
